title: Pure Prophecy
summary: Prophecy (Spellbook) is a Spellcaster toolbox control strategy where chaining 'Spellbook' Spell Cards (Spellbook of Secrets, Spellbook of Knowledge, Spellbook of the Master, and Spellbook of Fate) fuels The Grand Spellbook Tower and Spellbook of Judgment! With Spellbook of Judgment Unlimited in the TCG, activate Spellbook of Secrets -> Spellbook of the Master (copying Secrets) -> Spellbook of Knowledge/Power/Tower under Spellbook of Judgment: during the End Phase, Judgment adds 'Spellbook' Spells from your Deck up to the number of Spells activated this turn AND Special Summons High Priestess of Prophecy directly from your Deck while Spellbook of Fate banishes any card on the opponent's field without targeting!

allow.Magicians' Souls: Level 1 DARK Spellcaster that sends High Priestess of Prophecy from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself (providing a second Spellcaster alongside Spellbook Magician of Prophecy for Link-2 Crowley, the First Propheseer!) AND sends extra Spellbooks to draw up to 2 cards!
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters from all the Spellbook Spells in both GYs, then removes 3 counters during either Main Phase to Special Summon High Priestess of Prophecy from your hand or GY!

main: Spellbook Magician of Prophecy
Core Level 2 WATER Spellcaster starter ('Blue Boy'): when Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, adds ANY 'Spellbook' Spell Card from your Deck to your hand!
High Priestess of Prophecy

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Spellcaster boss (2500 ATK): reveals 3 'Spellbook' Spell Cards in your hand to Special Summon itself from your hand; once per turn banishes 1 Spellbook Spell from hand or GY to target 1 card on field and destroy it!
Justice of Prophecy

Level 3 EARTH Spellcaster: during the End Phase of a turn in which you activated a Spellbook Spell, banishes itself from field to add BOTH 1 Level 5+ LIGHT/DARK Spellcaster AND 1 'Spellbook' Spell Card from Deck to hand!
Temperance of Prophecy

Level 3 EARTH Spellcaster: during your Main Phase, if you have activated a Spellbook Spell this turn, tributes itself to Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT or DARK Spellcaster directly from your Deck!
World of Prophecy
Level 9 LIGHT Spellcaster boss (2900 ATK): adds 2 'Spellbook' Spells from GY to hand on Summon, and reveals 4 Spellbook Spells in hand to destroy ALL other cards on the field!
Magicians' Souls
Sends High Priestess of Prophecy or World of Prophecy from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself, or sends extra Spellbooks from hand to draw 2 cards.
Spellbook of Secrets
Core Normal Spell: adds ANY 'Spellbook' card (including Spellbook Magician of Prophecy!) from your Deck to your hand.
Spellbook of Judgment

Iconic Quick-Play Spell: during the End Phase, adds 'Spellbook' Spells from Deck to hand up to the number of Spells activated, THEN Special Summons 1 Spellcaster monster from your Deck whose Level is <= the number of cards added!
Spellbook of the Master
Reveals 1 other Spellbook in hand while you control a Spellcaster to copy the effect of any 'Spellbook' Normal Spell in your GY!
Spellbook of Knowledge
Sends 1 Spellcaster you control or 1 other Spellbook card from your hand/field to the GY to draw 2 cards.
Spellbook of Fate

Signature Quick-Play Spell: banishes up to 3 'Spellbook' Spells from GY to return 1 Set Spell/Trap to hand, flip 1 monster face-down/face-up, OR banish 1 card your opponent controls WITHOUT targeting!
Spellbook of Eternity
Targets 1 of your banished 'Spellbook' Spell Cards and adds it back to your hand.
Spellbook of Wisdom
Quick-Play Spell that makes 1 Spellcaster on the field completely unaffected by other Spell effects OR Trap effects this turn.
Spellbook of Power
Gives 1 Spellcaster you control +1000 ATK and searches any Spellbook Spell when it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Spellbook of Life
Equip Spell that banishes 1 Spellcaster from your GY and reveals 1 other Spellbook in hand to revive a Spellcaster from your GY!
The Grand Spellbook Tower
Signature Field Spell: during Standby Phase, places 1 Spellbook Spell from GY on the bottom of your Deck to draw 1 card; and Special Summons a Spellcaster when destroyed!
extra: Signature Link-2 DARK Spellcaster: reveals 3 'Spellbook' cards with different names from Deck on Link Summon for opponent to add 1 to hand; grants 1 Tribute-free Normal Summon of a Level 5+ Spellcaster each turn!
Signature Rank 7 DARK Spellcaster Xyz boss: detaches 1 material once per turn to destroy Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls up to the number of 'Spellbook' Spell Cards in your GY!
Signature Rank 5 LIGHT Spellcaster Xyz that excavates top 5 cards and destroys monsters up to the number of Spellbooks revealed.
Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters for every Spellbook in both GYs and revives High Priestess of Prophecy or World of Prophecy during either Main Phase!
